payload.prompt: We have discovered errors in the general ledger for January and February 2026. Review all vouchers and find the 4 errors: a posting to the wrong account (account 7100 used instead of 7140, amount 6400 NOK), a duplicate voucher (account 7300, amount 1100 NOK), a missing VAT line (account 6500, amount excl. 19350 NOK missing VAT on account 2710), and an incorrect amount (account 6540, 20500 NOK posted instead of 12150 NOK). Correct all errors with appropriate correction vouchers.

payload.goal: Review January and February 2026 vouchers, identify the 4 specified ledger errors, and correct them with appropriate correction vouchers.
likely_resources: Voucher list for January and February 2026
VAT settings and correction voucher endpoint
success_checks: Voucher using account 7100 for 6400 NOK is corrected so net effect is on account 7140 instead of 7100
Duplicate voucher on account 7300 for 1100 NOK is fully reversed once
Missing VAT for 19350 NOK excl. VAT on account 6500 is added with correct VAT line on account 2710
Incorrect amount on account 6540 is reduced from 20500 NOK to 12150 NOK via correction of 8350 NOK
All correction vouchers are dated within an appropriate correction period and balanced
risk_notes: Original voucher IDs are not provided; matching vouchers must be identified by period, account, and amount
Debit/credit direction is not stated for the original postings; correction entries must mirror actual voucher direction
VAT rate is not explicitly stated, but 'missing VAT' implies standard VAT unless source document indicates otherwise
Correction date is not specified; posting date for correction vouchers may need accounting policy confirmation
If periods are locked, corrections may need to be posted in a later open period instead of January/February 2026
payload.suggested_first_action: Fetch all vouchers and ledger transactions for 2026-01-01 to 2026-02-28 and isolate entries matching accounts 7100, 7300, 6500, 2710, and 6540 with the stated amounts.

line_items.description: Reclassify wrong account posting from 7100 to 7140
Add missing VAT for posting on account 6500, base amount excl. VAT
Correct overstated amount on account 6540 from 20500 to 12150

ordered_steps: GET ledger/vouchers for date range 2026-01-01 to 2026-02-28
GET general ledger transactions for accounts 7100, 7140, 7300, 6500, 2710, and 6540 in the same period
Identify the voucher where 7100 was used instead of 7140 for 6400 NOK and capture voucher ID plus debit/credit direction
Create correction voucher reversing 6400 NOK on account 7100 and reposting 6400 NOK to account 7140 with mirrored balancing lines as needed
Identify the duplicate voucher on account 7300 for 1100 NOK and confirm which of the two is duplicate
POST reverse voucher for the duplicate 7300 voucher, or create a manual correction voucher that fully offsets the duplicate entry
Identify the voucher on account 6500 for 19350 NOK excl. VAT that is missing VAT line on account 2710
Create correction voucher adding VAT line on account 2710 for 4837.5 NOK and corresponding balancing entry according to original voucher structure
Identify the voucher on account 6540 posted as 20500 NOK instead of 12150 NOK and capture debit/credit direction
Create correction voucher reducing the net posting on account 6540 by 8350 NOK with proper balancing entry
Re-fetch affected vouchers and ledger balances to verify all four corrections are posted and net balances are corrected

planned_endpoints.summary: Find vouchers corresponding with sent data.
Reverses the voucher, and returns the reversed voucher. Supports reversing most voucher types, except salary transactions.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: REQUIRES dateFrom and dateTo as query params. Without them you get 422.
dateTo is EXCLUSIVE — if you want vouchers from March 22, use dateTo=2026-03-23 (next day).
NEVER use dateFrom == dateTo — it always returns 422. Always set dateTo = dateFrom + 1 day minimum.
Example for single day: params={"dateFrom": "2026-03-22", "dateTo": "2026-03-23"}
Example for broad range: params={"dateFrom": "2026-01-01", "dateTo": "2026-12-31"}
These are QUERY PARAMS via the params field — NOT json_body.
Method is PUT, not POST.
date is a QUERY PARAMETER: PUT /ledger/voucher/{id}/:reverse?date=YYYY-MM-DD
Do NOT send date in the request body.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.

For supplier costs: use TWO postings — (1) DEBIT expense account with vatType=3 and amountGross=GROSS amount, (2) CREDIT account 2400 with vatType=0 and amountGross=NEGATIVE GROSS amount with supplier ref. Tripletex auto-splits the debit into net+VAT. A SINGLE debit posting with vatType=3 causes 422 on many accounts. ALWAYS include the credit to 2400. Ignore legalVatTypes — vatType=3 works for auto-split even when not listed.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': add matching credit posting with vatType=0, or switch to two-posting approach (debit vatType=3 + credit vatType=0).
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For ANY posting on account 2400 (Leverandørgjeld), ALWAYS include supplier={"id": supplier_id}.
For ANY posting on account 1500 (Kundefordringer), ALWAYS include customer={"id": customer_id}.
Month-end depreciation: debit a 6000-series depreciation expense (e.g., 6010), credit accumulated depreciation (typically 1039/1049/1059) — do NOT credit 1209.
Month-end payroll accrual: derive amount from actual salary transactions/postings in period; NEVER invent a payroll amount.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.

Also clarify whether reversing a duplicate voucher is preferable when voucher id is found.

payload.headline: Token reuse caused 403 errors on all API calls; 4/7 checks passed via pre-existing state
what_went_wrong: All 4 Tripletex API calls failed with 403 'Invalid or expired proxy token' — the agent reused a token that was already consumed, blocking all data retrieval.
The agent made 20 total calls with 20 errors (100% failure rate), meaning no ledger data was fetched and no correction vouchers could be created.
Checks 5, 6, and 7 failed — likely corresponding to the missing VAT line correction, incorrect amount correction, and/or duplicate voucher correction that required API interaction.
The planner queued parallel API calls before verifying token validity, causing cascading 403 failures across all account queries (7100, 7300, 6500, 6540).
what_worked: 4 out of 7 checks passed (score 5/8), suggesting some corrections were already present or pre-scored from prior state.
Endpoint inspection calls succeeded, indicating the inspect tool does not consume the proxy token.
what_to_try_next: Make a single lightweight API call (e.g., GET /ledger/voucher with minimal params) immediately after init to validate the token before batching requests.
Avoid reusing tokens across submissions — ensure each run initializes a fresh session token before any Tripletex API calls.

Reduce parallel API calls: fetch all relevant postings in one broader call (accountNumberFrom=6500, accountNumberTo=7300) rather than 4 separate account-specific calls to minimize token consumption risk.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/postingByDate for account 7300 — failed due to token reuse, same root cause as first call
GET /ledger/postingByDate for account 6500 — redundant given token was already invalid after first call
GET /ledger/postingByDate for account 6540 — all 4 account queries could be merged into one broader range call
